hooks.if: Bash(node tools/build-standalone* || npm install* || npm ci* || netlify build* || netlify deploy*)

hooks.command: if [ -f "$file_path" ]; then lines=$(wc -l < "$file_path"); if [ "$lines" -gt 500 ] && [ -z "$offset" ]; then echo "⚠️  Large file ($lines lines) read without offset/limit — consider: grep -n 'symbol' $file_path, then Read with offset"; fi; fi
